scope: One focused test after user corrected the asset setup and limited usage. Main-agent implementation and personal critique; no new paired runs or critic agents.

evals.name: apollo-real-archive-experience
evals.prompt: Build a coherent high-ambition expressive editorial experience about Apollo 11 using eight supplied real NASA archival photographs, an actual NASA montage/captions and licensed local fonts. The visual idea must extend across the opening, authored mission sequence, original truthful motion graphics, human-scale encounter, inspectable source archive and resolution. Use media deliberately with typography, colour, transitions and native-scroll continuity; no generated replacement images, invented telemetry, fake NASA affiliation, generic photo shuffle or dead controls. Retain a deliberate phone, keyboard and reduced-motion experience. Main agent personally reviews pixels, temporal states and actual tasks, repairs demonstrated causes in the skill and reopens affected paths. Complete this one focused case without broad benchmarking.
evals.expected_output: Runnable site, desktop/mobile/temporal/task evidence, personal critique and documented skill corrections.
assertions: All eight original photographs have honest identities and NASA record links
Chapter image/title/credit remain synchronized under rapid selection
Archive filtering and keyboard photograph viewing work
Archival film advances, captions load and playback pauses on close
Reflow at 320/390/1024/1440 and reduced-motion paths retain core tasks

limits: One maker-reviewed development example cannot establish comparative superiority, independent human preference, award eligibility or full accessibility/field performance. Earlier inadequate generated-image setups are private diagnostic work, not representative award-level tests.
